title: Estructuras condicionales contrafácticas con 'de haber + participio'
goal: Deploy abbreviated counterfactual conditional structures with 'de haber + participio' in formal, academic, and journalistic registers.
grammar: estructuras condicionales contrafácticas implícitas con de haber + participio

items: Transform 'si hubiera + participio' into elegant 'de haber + participio' clauses.
Place clitic pronouns correctly attached to the auxiliary infinitive (de habérselo dicho).
Interpret counterfactual clauses in formal legal, investigative, and historical reports.
